Talent0_2Ability.name: Σ-04
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When using an Alter-Blade to actively attack and destroy a target, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1015414>[Critical Sense]</buf> after combat, stacking up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times. Removed at the start of the next action.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Σ-04
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When using an Alter-Blade to actively attack and destroy a target, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1015414>[Critical Sense]</buf> after combat, stacking up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times. Removed at the start of the next action.
When deployed, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1015414>[Critical Sense]</buf>. When an Arm would be destroyed, triggers <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf> to lock its HP at <color=#F74848>1</color>. Can trigger again after <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101509.name: Twin Wing Slash
101509.describe: Attacks a target with two Alter-Blades, dealing <color=#F74848>0.85</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times.

700034.name: Within Our Grasp
700034.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if HP percentage is greater than or equal to the target's, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

101503.name: Indulgent Edge
101503.SpecificEffects: When subjected to a missile attack, if equipped with two Alter-Blades and both Arms are undestroyed, consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900100>[Critical Sense]</buf> to become immune to DMG from the first <color=#F74848>2</color> Missile Launcher hits.

101504.name: Ruthless Strike
101504.describe: Uses an Alter-Blade to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2</color>x DMG. This attack targets the part with the highest HP.

101505.name: Phantom Pain
101505.describe: Requires two Alter-Blades to be equipped. Immediately gains <color=#F74848>2</color> AP and <buf ID=1015052>[Critical State]</buf>, lasting until the end of the action. Can continue action with full Movement.

101506.name: Rotating Slash
101506.describe: Uses two Alter-Blades to attack in a designated direction, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2</color>x DMG to the target. Prioritizes attacking parts with less than full HP. If there are adjacent enemies in that direction, can continue to attack adjacent units (attacking up to <color=#F74848>3</color> enemy units), then stops on the opposite side of the farthest target. If <color=#F74848>2</color> or more enemy units are hit, can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf> after combat, and act again with full Movement.

101507.name: Duplicity
101507.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900109>[Execution]</buf> or <buf ID=900100>[Critical Sense]</buf> to destroy a part, restores <color=#F74848>15%</color> HP to all undestroyed parts. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101508.name: Blade Havoc
101508.describe: Uses two Alter-Blades to strike a single target in rapid succession, hitting at least <color=#F74848>4</color> times. Each attack deals <color=#F74848>0.7</color>x DMG. Each additional <color=#F74848>1</color> attack costs <color=#F74848>1</color> AP until any part is destroyed or AP runs out. Ignores the Large Shield <buf ID=900027>[Target Shift]</buf> effect.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101531.name: Terminator 1
101531.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking with an Alter-Blade, if the part hit is below <color=#F74848>15%</color> HP, triggers the <buf ID=900109>[Execution]</buf> effect, directly destroying that part after combat.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

101534.name: Terminator 2
101534.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1015311>[Terminator 1]</buf> part destruction effect threshold increased to <color=#F74848>25%</color> HP.

101535.name: Terminator 3
101535.SpecificEffects: When activating <buf ID=900101>[Terminator]</buf> to destroy a part, negates the deduction of <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf> count and additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101536.name: Terminator 4
101536.SpecificEffects: When using an Alter-Blade to destroy parts other than the Body, inflicts <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> on the Body equal to <color=#F74848>25%</color> of the destroyed part's Max HP.

101541.name: Pride 1
101541.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with an Alter-Blade and destroying a part, after combat gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900100>[Critical Sense]</buf>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101544.name: Pride 2
101544.SpecificEffects: When possessing <buf ID=900100>[Critical Sense]</buf>, Hit Rate and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

101545.name: Pride 3
101545.SpecificEffects: After taking damage, if HP is below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, restores <color=#F74848>10%</color> HP to all parts after combat, repairs <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part, and gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900100>[Critical Sense]</buf>. This effect can only trigger once after every <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

101546.name: Pride 4
101546.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900100>[Critical Sense]</buf> prioritizes attacking Arms carrying weapons. If the part hit is below <color=#F74848>30%</color> HP, triggers an <buf ID=900109>[Execution]</buf> effect, directly destroying that part after combat.
